overallVerdict.WB-E004: Not established visually. A/C show decisive outcomes and damage logs support consequential melee pressure, but sampled stills do not explain commitments, hits, or counters. B is worse on sustained consequence: 120-second timeout with a reported 103-second maximum damage gap.
overallVerdict.WB-E005: Partial positional readability, insufficient pressure readability. Separate red/blue figures make spacing legible in B/C, but tiny fighters, health bars, and projectiles make attack state and initiative difficult to infer. B late activity lacks changing stakes.

observations.visual: A fighters nearly overlap; B/C have visible separation. A/C blue is at 34 HP, B blue at 100 HP. Color and spacing read more readily than attack state.
observations.interpretation: A/C have established meaningful damage; no sampled pose identifies a punishable commitment.

observations.visual: A shows red wins at 9.8 seconds. B has red 60/blue 100; C red 80/blue 34. B/C remain separated.

observations.visual: B remains in progress with small orange projectiles and the same red 30/blue 90 as at 19 seconds.

preference.choice: No adoption recommendation; A/C preferred over B for demonstrated consequence in this seed, with no defensible visual ranking between A and C from these samples.
preference.researchDirection: Keep B only as a spacing/telegraph research branch after resolving long non-damaging loops. Its separation is useful but does not outweigh the stalled outcome.
preference.priorOpinion: Earlier tentative preference for B is not retained after inspecting the 90-second state and timeout summary.
preference.uncertainty: High for moment-to-moment readability and commitment; moderate for rejecting B sustained pressure in this particular duel seed. No numeric fun score.
